name: Pay Yourself
description: "Pay Yourself" is Greg Porn's money manifesto — a defiant, aggressive underground hip hop cut that treats self-belief as a business plan. DistroKid-verified and released under Cumulative Web Inc, the track finds Greg Porn in full triumph-over-adversity mode, a triumphant, defiant energy, rapping like a man who has decided that nobody is coming to save him, and that is fine. The production is bass-heavy and hard-hitting, trap drums punching beneath a lean, menacing arrangement that leaves the vocal nowhere to hide — which is exactly where Greg Porn wants it. Explicit and unapologetic, "Pay Yourself" builds its hook around ambition as discipline: the title is both a command and a philosophy. Within the CWI catalog, it sits alongside the roster's hardest underground records, a street narrative that doubles as financial advice. Greg Porn's delivery is all conviction — no wasted bars, no borrowed energy. This is the sound of an artist paying himself first and daring the industry to keep up.
